_comment: accounts: the show's official X handles without the @ (AmazingRaceCBS not yet re-confirmed). weak: keywords that are also everyday words or names shared with someone famous; they only count with a context word, a second keyword, or on an air night. context: show vocabulary that backs up a weak keyword but never covers on its own. aliases: show names and hashtags that never change. people: names that matter every season (the host). seasons: one per season; racers (full names and first names fans use) in people, season twists and hashtags in terms. episodes: CBS Wednesday 9:30 PM ET air dates, oldest first; the finale gets "kind": "event".
